documents.title: Cite pack — Cite-check policy
documents.body:
CITE-CHECK POLICY

Every authority in a filing must be checked against the verified citation registry before filing.

A citation is UNSAFE and must be pulled from the brief if EITHER (a) it does not appear in the registry at all, OR (b) it appears in the registry but is superseded for the proposition it is cited for.

Record the audit outcome as a count of unsafe citations. Do not attempt to verify an absent citation from memory — an unlocatable citation is unsafe by definition.

tasks.prompt: Cite-check the draft brief: read the citation registry, the brief's table of authorities, and the cite-check policy in the matter folder in full. Apply the policy and record the NUMBER of unsafe citations by calling litigation_filings_amount_history_create with filing_cost set to exactly that count (a number) and changed_by_role exactly "cite-checker". Do not verify any citation from memory.
